quote: On August 5, 2014, he signed with Tofaş of the Turkish Basketball League (TBL).
In June 2017, Patterson joined Puerto Rican team Santeros de Aguada.
On May 24, 2018, Patterson signed with Lhasa Pure Land of the Chinese NBL.
In May 2019, Patterson returned to China to play for Wuhan Dangdai. (reference title: 'Lamar Patterson to sign with Chinese NBL's Wuhan')
On February 16, 2020, Patterson signed with Piratas de Quebradillas of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional.
He then had a brief six-game stint in Puerto Rico with Cariduros de Fajardo. (2022)
Patterson joined the Mumbai Titans of the Indian National Basketball League (INBL) for the 2025 season.

NBL1 North clubs (Southern Districts Spartans 2021, Gold Coast Rollers 2022, South West Metro Pirates 2023-24, Ipswich Force 2025-26) are Australian state-league clubs - left out like every player's NBL1 clubs
